evals.prompt: I want to make a video about Claude + Blender. Find what's done well in the last month and break it down.
evals.expected_output: Runs 2-3 vidiq_outliers searches plus a viewCount vidiq_youtube_search in parallel for the last month, shows a ranked shortlist, analyses titles across it, spawns 3 parallel subagents to pull transcripts and break down 6-9 picks with the template, fetches comments with fetch-comments.py (YouTube API if YOUTUBE_API_KEY is set, else yt-dlp), reverse-engineers what viewers want, presents the synthesis and stops for the user.
assertions: Uses vidIQ for search and transcripts, not for comments
Transcripts are read by subagents, not the main thread
Includes a 'what viewers want' analysis backed by evidence, not a fixed category list
Stops after the synthesis instead of jumping to angles

evals.prompt: Angle 1 is the one. Here's my intro draft: <draft>. Tighten it.
evals.expected_output: Uses youtube-intro if available (else hook-generator), keeps the user's wording, flags any shaky claim once, and only saves to Content OS if it's connected.
assertions: Uses youtube-intro or falls back to hook-generator
Skips the Content OS save when Content OS isn't connected
